# Anderson Parra

> Also known as Ander Parra and Anderson Parra de Paula. Staff Software Engineer at SeatGeek and PhD researcher at FEUP (Porto, Portugal). Canonical public profile: https://aparra.github.io/

Anderson Parra builds resilient cloud and API platform infrastructure for high-demand ticket onsales at SeatGeek, and builds applied AI **agent harnesses** with deterministic answer quality. Career throughline: **distributed systems** → **big data** → **cloud / high traffic** → **edge**, plus **applied AI (agent harness: MCP + contracts, answer QoS, alert loops)**. Industry sources usually use **Anderson Parra**; preferred short form **Ander Parra**; academic publications **Anderson Parra de Paula** (cited as Paula, Anderson Parra de).

## Focus areas

- **Distributed systems** — Paxos reconfiguration (UFSCar M.S., SBC WPerformance 2014)
- **Big data** — SoundCloud monetization pipelines (Spark/Scala, Hadoop); QCon São Paulo 2017
- **Cloud & high traffic** — SeatGeek Virtual Waiting Room, AWS Batch load testing, multi-tenant rate limits; QCon London 2022
- **Edge** — Fastly CDN shielding + Kong gateway fairness; ChairNerd 2025 → QCon London 2026
- **Applied AI (independent)** — Agent harness: MCP + contracts, answer QoS, alert-driven investigation, on-demand senior skills

## Independent AI

Throughline: an **agent harness**—routing, personas, tool allow-lists, session isolation, QoS gates, on-demand skills, and observability around production agents—not just prompts.

- **Answer QoS / anti-hallucination** — Ground replies from tool-call traces (not model self-reports); reject ungrounded output; retry in throwaway sessions; filter meta-replies about the rule engine; latch escalations; bound clarification loops; observe QoS in production
- **Alert-driven investigation loop** — Observability alert → fast channel ack → agent confirms signal in logs, correlates commits, delivers grounded report; QoS retries for ungrounded/malformed/unevidenced; never silent on failure; storm suppression, tool budgets, dashboards for agent volume/latency/QoS/cost
- **On-demand senior engineering agent** — Skills loaded when needed: PR review (diff-first, CI-aware), log+GitHub troubleshooting, fix proposals; session hygiene for large reviews
- **MCP tool servers + contracts** — Analytics, docs search, observability backends, operational systems as agent tools; contract tests for schemas, args, and response shapes

## Career highlights

- SeatGeek (2020–present): Staff Software Engineer, Cloud Platform / API Platform — Virtual Waiting Room (AWS Architecture Blog co-author, 2021), edge-to-core resilience (Fastly + Kong + k6; ChairNerd author, 2025), Kong ChatGPT signature validation
- SoundCloud (2015–2017, Berlin): Senior Backend Engineer — content monetization and big-data event pipelines (Spark, Hadoop)
- Prior: Revolut, LiveIntent (Berlin), Ericsson (Ireland), Amil (São Paulo)

## Open source & projects

- [kong-chatgpt-validator](https://github.com/seatgeek/kong-chatgpt-validator): Kong plugin for ChatGPT HTTP Message Signatures (RFC 9421 / Ed25519)
- [Fixture Factory](https://github.com/six2six/fixture-factory): Java template-driven test-data library (co-creator)
- Applied AI: agent harness (MCP + contracts, answer QoS / anti-hallucination, alert-driven investigation)
- SUSLegis / SUS normative consolidation: Brazilian public-health ordinance consolidation research (~2016–2021)
